typography.font_pairings: VT323 for pet name, time chips, and numerical elements. Nunito for soft, readable body text in notes and inputs.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Chunky, cozy spacing with clear borders.
spacing_and_layout.ui_style: Cozy Game Flat UI - flat backgrounds with hard solid-color drop shadows (e.g., shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#4A3B32]) to simulate a retro/pixel tactile feel.

panel.classes: bg-[#FDFBF7] border-4 border-[#4A3B32] rounded-xl shadow-[6px_6px_0px_#4A3B32] overflow-hidden

button.classes: bg-[#E07A5F] text-[#FDFBF7] font-bold border-2 border-[#4A3B32] rounded-lg shadow-[3px_3px_0px_#4A3B32] active:translate-y-[3px] active:translate-x-[3px] active:shadow-none transition-all
button.secondary_classes: bg-[#F2CC8F] text-[#4A3B32] font-bold border-2 border-[#4A3B32] rounded-lg shadow-[3px_3px_0px_#4A3B32] active:translate-y-[3px] active:translate-x-[3px] active:shadow-none transition-all

input.classes: w-full bg-white border-2 border-[#4A3B32] rounded-lg p-3 text-[#4A3B32] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E07A5F]

speech_bubble.classes: bg-[#FDFBF7] border-2 border-[#4A3B32] rounded-2xl rounded-tr-none shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#4A3B32] p-4
speech_bubble.description: Pure CSS bubble anchored near the cat, avoiding the need for a complex image background to allow fluid text.

time_chip.classes: font-['VT323'] bg-[#F2CC8F] border border-[#4A3B32] rounded text-sm px-2 py-1 shadow-[2px_2px_0px_#4A3B32]

animations.cat_idle: CSS keyframes for gentle bobbing up and down (translateY: -2px to 2px, duration 2s, infinite ease-in-out)
animations.cat_walk: CSS keyframes for slight side-to-side waddle with rotation (rotate: -5deg to 5deg, translateY, duration 0.5s, infinite)
animations.cat_hop: CSS keyframes for a quick jump (translateY: -20px, duration 0.3s, ease-out, returning to 0)
animations.draggable: framer-motion drag with dragElastic and dragConstraints. On dragEnd, animate back to x:0, y:0 if it should ease back to top right.

cat_sprite.description: The pixel-art chunky cat. MUST be styled with 'image-rendering: pixelated'. Use as the main pet character.

demo_background.description: The cozy desk background to be used as a full-screen or large container background to demonstrate the app overlaying content.

speech_bubble_asset.description: Optional speech bubble asset if pure CSS isn't preferred. But CSS is recommended for dynamic text.

accessibility.contrast: High contrast ensured with #4A3B32 text on light cream backgrounds.
accessibility.focus_states: Hard focus rings using the primary color #E07A5F.
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='pet-character', data-testid='notes-panel', data-testid='add-reminder-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the codebase uses standard JavaScript (.js / .jsx), DO NOT USE TypeScript (.ts / .tsx).
Use framer-motion for the pet's draggable behavior and panel entrance animations.

Implement the 'Cozy Game UI' aesthetic: hard borders, hard shadows (no blurring), rounded corners. DO NOT use Shadcn defaults here as they are too clean/corporate. Rely on raw HTML/Tailwind for these custom surfaces.

For the LLM integration, structure the application so that natural language parsing (e.g., 'tomorrow at 5pm') can be connected seamlessly. If the actual LLM API is unavailable, implement a robust fallback or mocked utility that extracts basic time data so the app flow remains unbroken.
Persist all notes, reminders, pet's name, and last interaction timestamp to localStorage.
The pet character MUST be 'fixed' positioned relative to the viewport, anchored to the top right z-[100] so it floats above everything.
Use CSS keyframes for the continuous pet idle/walk animations so they run smoothly without triggering React re-renders.
When moving left/right along the top edge, use CSS transforms (e.g., scaleX(-1)) to flip the sprite so it faces the direction of movement.
